congress.latency: STOCK Act allows up to 45 days from trade to filing. Parsed 804 of 804 electronic House and 267 of 267 Senate reports filed since 2025-01-03. Lag is filed date minus trade date. Senate amendments keep the original report date and list the amendment date separately.
errors: 113 House and 0 Senate reports since 2025-01-03 are scanned paper filings and are not parsed.

insiders.latency: Form 4 is due two business days after the trade. Rows are the latest eight Form 4s per join-table issuer. Code P is an open-market buy, S a sale, A a grant, F tax withholding.

whales.latency: Quarter-end holdings filed up to 45 days after quarter end. 21 of 21 named funds in data/whales.json; change is this 13F against the one before. Issuers matched by name to the join table. Options excluded.

shorts.latency: Settlement-date snapshots published twice a month, about a week after settlement.
